content.question: How do Q-Learning and SARSA differ in terms of policy?
options: Q-Learning is on-policy, while SARSA is off-policy.
Q-Learning is off-policy, while SARSA is on-policy and learns the value of taking actions according to the current policy.
Both are off-policy and always follow the greedy policy.
Both are on-policy; the difference lies only in the learning rate.
content.answer: Q-Learning is off-policy, while SARSA is on-policy and learns the value of taking actions according to the current policy.
